milestone.title: CRITICAL BUG FIX: Gmail Message → Text regex corruption
milestone.detail: Discovered critical parsing error blocking workflow execution. The stripHtml function in Gmail Message → Text node had corrupted escape sequences where \r\n and \n were converted to literal newlines, breaking regex patterns with "missing /" error. Root cause: JSON export/import lost backslash escaping. Solution: Completely reconstructed stripHtml function with proper escape sequences, verified all 10 .replace() calls, removed duplicate lines. Created upload-ready files at handoff/workflow_export_ready_fixed.json and handoff/workflow_READY_TO_UPLOAD.json. Comprehensive status report with upload instructions created at handoff/STATUS_2025-10-06.md. API upload failed due to auth issues - manual upload through n8n UI required.
